title: Moving weekday calendar
details: The bottom progress arches are replaced by a compact scrollable weekday calendar with Today centred
Tap any day to view the schedule or add a Review, Observation, Witness Testimony, Meeting or other booking
Completed observations and reviews appear automatically on their recorded dates, while next review dates are shown as due bookings
Manual bookings can be linked to a learner and remain stored locally on this device
The calendar remains available offline and is only slightly taller than the previous arch bar
